url.description: ArangoDB URL, e.g. http://localhost:8529. Hosts may be restricted by setting SCHEMA_ANALYZER_ALLOWED_HOSTS in the server environment.

systemPrompt.description: Optional override; default is strict JSON-only. Hard limit 64 KiB to bound request size.

domainContext.description: Optional caller-supplied business-domain priors (PRD §4.7). Overrides automatic domain detection for LLM prompt context. Either a domain-name string or an object; entities/relationships (if given) supply the typical-vocabulary block.

detectForeignKeys.description: Infer relationships carried by scalar reference attributes (document-modelled foreign keys), not just edge collections. Name-anchored candidates ({singular}_id/{singular}Id/camelCase where a matching collection exists, plus 'Collection/key'-shaped values), each emitted as an inferred relationship (style FOREIGN_KEY, enforced=false, with a confidence and evidence). Deterministic and read-only; snapshot-only unless sampleForeignKeyOverlap is set.

sampleForeignKeyOverlap.description: When detectForeignKeys is set, additionally confirm each candidate by sampling values against the target collection's keys (bounded probe budget). Off by default because it issues extra AQL; raises confidence and vetoes coincidental name matches.

declaredReferences.description: Curator-declared attribute references for document stores (chunks.document_id -> documents._key). Each is verified against the database by full containment (every non-null value must resolve, compared strictly) and merged as a declared relationship (FOREIGN_KEY, method 'declared', outranking an inferred one for the same reference). A declaration that does not hold, names an unmapped collection, or has no non-null values fails the request with INVALID_ARGUMENT rather than being dropped.

graphScope.description: Restrict snapshot/analysis to one ArangoDB named graph's collections (edge collections + their from/to vertices + orphan collections). Bounds cost / LLM egress / focus. INVALID_ARGUMENT if the named graph does not exist. Omit to analyze the whole database (membership of every named graph is still labeled in metadata.graphMembership).

directory.description: Cache directory path. When SCHEMA_ANALYZER_CACHE_ROOT is set in the server environment, this path (after resolution) must lie under that root or the request is rejected.

redaction.description: Controls what is scrubbed from the physical snapshot before it is sent to the configured LLM provider (data egress). Has no effect on the no-LLM baseline path or on the local snapshot used for fingerprinting, baseline inference, reconciliation, and statistics.

stripSamples.description: Remove sampled documents/edges (sample_documents, sample_edges) from each collection before egress.

maskFieldValues.description: Replace concrete values in sample_field_value_counts with opaque tokens, preserving field names, distinct-value counts, and frequencies.

maskFieldNames.description: Replace document field names with opaque 'redacted_field_N' tokens before egress, then round-trip them back to the real names in the LLM output (conceptual schema + physical mapping are unaffected). System fields (_key/_from/_to/…) are preserved.

goldReference.description: Optional gold reference for precision/recall scoring of the conceptual schema (PRD §3.12.3). A domain-pack-style object {entities:[{name}], relationships:[{type}]}. When present, the analyze result's metadata.qualityMetrics gains a 'gold' block and its overlap folds into healthScore.

outputOptions.description: Controls what the response payload includes. JSON serialization concerns (indentation, line endings, etc.) are the caller's responsibility and are NOT part of this contract.

includeSnapshot.description: When true, the analyze result includes the full snapshot under result.snapshot.

includeSnapshotFingerprint.description: When false, tooling.snapshotFingerprint is omitted from the response. Default true preserves existing behavior.

owlFormat.description: Serialization for the owl operation. 'turtle' returns result.turtle; 'jsonld' returns result.jsonld.

input.description: Used for operations that transform existing analysis/snapshot payloads.

PhysicalSnapshot.description: Physical schema snapshot as produced by snapshot_physical_schema(). Hosts that expose this contract to untrusted callers SHOULD enforce a request-body size cap at the transport layer (e.g. a few MiB); the analyzer treats nested fields as trusted snapshot data.
